 School Holiday Tomorrow, November 13, 2026: Schools closed in Meghalaya, Rajasthan; check state-wise updates
 SECTIONS School Holiday Tomorrow, November 13, 2026: Schools closed in Meghalaya, Rajasthan; check state-wise updates By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 12, 2026, 05:01:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis School Holiday Tomorrow: On November 13, 2026, schools in India will adapt their schedules according to regional directives. In Delhi-NCR, younger students will switch to hybrid learning due to air quality issues. Meanwhile, Meghalaya schools will close for the Wangala Festival, with Himachal Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh staying open. West Bengal will implement a staggered reopening after Puja holidays, while Rajasthan students enjoy mid-term vacations.
 Agencies School Holiday Tomorrow, November 13, 2026: Schools closed in Meghalaya, Rajasthan; check state-wise updates
 School closures may vary across states and districts depending on government orders, weather conditions and regional holidays. A holiday in one state does not necessarily mean schools will remain closed across India. Schools in several parts of India may remain closed on Friday, November 13, 2026, due to extended Diwali vacations. However, there is no nationwide school holiday announcement for the date.
 School Holiday Tomorrow, November 13: State-Wise Status
 Delhi-NCR School Holiday Tomorrow 
 Schools across Delhi-NCR are not under a blanket closure order for Friday, November 13, 2026. However, worsening air pollution and the implementation of GRAP Stage III have prompted authorities to shift classes up to Class 5 to hybrid mode in Delhi and several NCR districts. The arrangement allows students to attend classes online or offline, wherever online facilities are available.
 Himachal Pradesh School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Himachal Pradesh are expected to function normally on Friday, November 13, 2026, as no statewide school holiday has been announced for the date.
 Meghalaya School Holiday Tomorrow 
 Live Events
 Schools across Meghalaya will remain closed on Friday, November 13, 2026, as the state government has declared a holiday to mark the traditional Wangala Festival, also known as the 100 Drums Festival.
 Uttar Pradesh school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools across Uttar Pradesh are expected to remain open on Friday, November 13, 2026, as no statewide school holiday has been announced for the date. The festive holidays for Diwali, Govardhan Puja and Bhai Dooj have already concluded.
 West Bengal school holiday tomorrow 
Schools across West Bengal are expected to reopen on Friday, November 13, 2026, following the extended Puja vacation that continued until November 12. However, reopening schedules may vary depending on individual school calendars and management decisions.
 Bihar School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools in Bihar are expected to remain open on Friday, November 13, as the date is not listed as a school holiday in the state's 2026 holiday calendar. However, the Chhath Puja break is scheduled to begin shortly, and students should check their school’s latest circular for confirmation.
 Odisha School Holiday Tomorrow 
There is no confirmed statewide order announcing the closure of schools across Odisha on November 13. Students are therefore expected to attend regular classes unless their respective schools or district administrations announce a separate holiday.
 Rajasthan School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Rajasthan, including Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur, Kota, Ajmer and Bikaner, will remain closed on Friday, November 13, 2026, as part of the ongoing mid-term vacation. The state is observing its scheduled school break from November 4 to November 15, with regular classes expected to resume on November 16.
